[SWS_DM_00905] Retrieving data for external DiagnosticDataEle- ments
⌈
If the Diagnostic Server instance is required to read data config-
ured as external DiagnosticDataElement, then the Diagnostic Server
instance shall utilize the associated RPortPrototype typed by the DataElement class ([SWS_DM_00603]) and call its DataElement::Read ([SWS_DM_00596])
function.
⌋
